name: Big Cubes in an Alliance Clubhouse 2025
information: This competition features only big cubes (4x4x4 Cube, 5x5x5 Cube, 6x6x6 Cube, and 7x7x7 Cube). This competition might not be recommended for first-time competitors as it will not be a traditional competition and does not include the normal 3x3x3 Cube. For those looking for a typical competition experience. Please consider instead any of the many [other competitions happening in Ohio](https://worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=ohio&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list).
